title: 🎶 LIVE LOOPING ECSTATIC DANCE with Beat Bishop
short_description: Lo-Fi • Soul • Ambient • House • Latin • Bass  🎤 Voice Activation 💃 Move your way.  ✨ Come as you are.
description:
A deep dance journey from slow & soulful beginnings to wild peaks and a soft landing. 🌀

We start together in the circle, arrive in the body, activate the voice — and then we dance. 💃

Beat Bishop guides the journey with a live-looping DJ set through Lo-Fi, Soul, Ambient Electronic, House, Latin & Bass, following the music and the energy of the room.

Come as you are.
Move your way.
Dance as much or as little as you like.

🎤 **Voice Activation**
A playful way to warm up the voice, connect with the group and get out of your head — no singing experience needed.

🎧 **Beat Bishop**
Live Looping Artist • DJ • Ecstatic Dance Musician
